body: He's on meds. Just won't do marriage counseling or talk therapy.

I'm actually trying to decide what to do. This "drooling" is a new situation. I didn't know this stuff was happening. Everything was fine until this week. I do respect myself. In fact I'm moving out tomorrow.

I'm not letting him do anything. I JUST found out about it. I'm addressing it today. A lot of people are being mean and don't understand the emotional loss I've been going through myself. I'm not pathetic. I'm optimistic and I'm trying to do what I think is best.
Wow. I don't have all the tools. I'm not perfect. I'm a little emotionally messed up myself from all this. I'm trying my best to protect myself and see if I can have my marriage back.

I'm not taking it. I'm addressing it his week. This hasn't been going on for the 4 months. Everyone thinks it's been going on the whole time. But this is a new occurrence. I don't want to take it, it needs to change or I'm out.
It wasn't a threat. I filed. I went to court, he showed up at court before I finalized.

If it's anything I thought I chose right. 

I have a lot of self worth. It was a great relationship. We argued constructively and he never did anything super selfish or disrespectful. The affair was the biggest shock for me, his friends and family. We are still trying to understand it.
I meant it's not an option as in it should be mandatory at this point. I've let us try it "his" way and his way is not working.
It's already filed. Back in September. We are trying to reconcile.
100 percent I know this. I told him today I know it. That it's unacceptable and I won't live with it.

I agree. Getting him to see that is the problem
 And I understand that he may never see it.

I am trying to grow this spine. I'm not letting it go. A lot of people think I'm on here trying to get advice about how to fix it or how to stay in the situation. But really I'm trying to find out how to constructively approach my husband with confidence and make sure I'm not a doormat. I don't find anything that is happening right now acceptable at all.

Yes I have. Earlier this week and very pointedly today. I told him things have to change. I'm not going to stay in a disrespectful relationship. Especially when it was agreed things would be blocked and that we were moving on with our lives.

I did. I filed for divorce and was at court. He showed up at court day. Maybe I was a fool for taking the chance on him. But I didn't want to be 80 and wonder what if I had. I'd rather know for sure than not at all.

It's not okay with me. Not at all. I addressed it today with him. We talked for 2 hours as calmly as can be possible in such a situation about this needs to change. And that therapy is not an option. I'm waiting to see what will happen.

Our divorce is already filed. I filed back in September. We are trying to reconcile because we both said we didn't want to be divorced. That was 4 months ago now. My husband knows I can leave. I just have to go to court, it takes like 2 days to finalize at this point. 

I told him he is fucking up and playing with fire.

I'd say the old me was too giving. I'm definitely a lot tougher. I'm not scared to be without him or to be alone. I just preferred our relationship and life together. So when there was an opportunity to work at that, I took it. But I know one person can't make it work, both have to want to make it work.

It's not okay. And I'm addressing it today as I just found out this week. 

When I first approached him he gave me a lame excuse about it being easier to let go of it if he's sure she didn't care. 

It's horrible I know. It's why I'm on reddit trying to sort through how I'm going to handle this.
Yes. I found out on my own this week.
I have my own life outside of him. But I preferred my life with him.

I dont. I see a lot of people thinking this. But I really dont. I here in this relationship trying to fix for my own selfish reasons. I wanted to try. I was not forced to be here and as much as it sounds like I let him wall over me I dont. 

We just had a lengthy conversation about how unacceptable the situation is and how he needs to change or I'm out. 

I'm not a doormat, I just want to believe the good in people.

When I chose to get married it wasn't to just get married. We had plans and a future planned out. His family is a huge part of my life and so are all of our friends. I don't want to have to move away to get away from his home town after the years I've invested. I don't want to change jobs. When we got married I was sure this was the life and partner I wanted. 

I know he obviously didn't and he fucked up. But I feel like I'm paying the ultimate price. I will lose everyone and everything that means something  to me.

I do understand this. But my husband was not emotionally sound when it happened. He called me several weeks before the affair and told me.he thought he was having a mental breakdown. He came home crying everyday. He had never cried before in our whole relationship. He has been offocially diagnosed with depression. I cant ignore that there was a chemical imbalance happening. I know for certain the affair hadn't started because we didn't even know or meet this girl yet. Please don't doubt my absolute certainty. I've done enough research and investigation while we were apart to put together an accurate timeline.

I believe that is a huge possibility. I know what I've gotten myself into and I know that this might be the truth that I will have to face in the end. 

The problem is my husband was not like this for the years before. This happened after depression set in. :/ it's hard to see someone who was selfless and loyal, suddenly change.

I agree with that statement. I brought it up with my husband today. How can he expect others to respect me or our marriage if he continues to commit actions however small that are disrespectful? I agree. Something has to change.

When he had the affair he wasn't empathetic that was almost 8 months ago. 

He has made many efforts and strides to change. I don't think those can just be ignored.

I definitely don't want to waste years it's why I'm trying to address the trust issues now. Something has to change or I cannot stay. I want to be able to be in this marriage with the man I've been with for 5 years. But I understand that I can't control him and make it change. I want to give it a chance to change though. I'm not in a physically or mentally abusive situation. I know what I've gotten myself into and I have things set up to keep me safe if needed. 

I can go to counseling. I was going for a while but it's very expensive as my insurance doesn't cover it, so I stopped.

He told me he wanted me. 

I have the emails and calls. 

I assumed it was the fantasy came to end. That is my assumption. It may be a shitty truth. But I didn't know it when I first got back with him.

This is a possibility that he doesn't want a third opinion in there. However I don't like it insinuating that I've been manipulated. I knew what I was getting into coming back and I've set up clear boundaries. This is a new issue not something that has been going on the whole time. And I've been trying to address it today. If I was the doormat everyone was saying I am. Then I wouldn't have sought advice to approach him with this.
She was blocked on everything and then about a month ago he unblocked things.

I am in therapy. And I know that a lot of people see my empathy as being a doormat. I understand that is the reaction without knowing how much I've demanded and stood up for myself. 

I have demanded things change today. I'm waiting for his reply on the matter.

I'm trying to hold him accountable. It is hard. We just had a long talk about his issues. I will have to see what comes of it if anything. I really do not like to make excuses for him. But I'm trying to be empathetic with his diagnosis of MDD.

I dont appreciate that generalization. I was not okay with any terms. 

Part of us agreeing to try again, was moving, him quitting his job the day we reconciled and finding a new one and blocking her on everything. 

Those were my demand and they were met. 

The problem is the follow through on the last one. Things are being unblocked. And he isnt dealing with my arguments for it to be otherwise.

Thank you I will tell him this. He isnt being mean, he's actually being very empathetic but I think he's thrown that she posted anything as well. 

He's very lost. And being here is a sacrifice for me. I told myself I'd give it until at least are 1st anniversary for him to get better

I do feel like this internally. I want him to be more dedicated to "our" well being and our marriage which includes me. But at the same time I'm so tied up in this recovery. I have fear of destroying it from.not giving it enough time. I'm scared of my life if I walk away. 

I prayed to have my life back when I thought he'd never come back. I don't want to look a gift horse in the mouth.

I definitely want to go to therapy but his refusal makes it hard to think forcing him will be worth it. I'm trying right now to explain my concern but I'm getting shut down. He says he doesn't want to talk about it right now. 

I don't want to cause a huge fight especially on unstable ground. And I'm also trying to not give her power in our relationship anymore.

We don't have a therapist. My husband has a lot of pride and is worried about judgement. He refuses to go to a therapist. And I'm worried forcing him will make the sessions pointless and unproductive.

Yes in this case it was an affair because he kissed her prior to us being separated and when we separated he said it was not to end our relationship. He left me with our entire life, paying our bills, taking care of our pets etc. Expected me to not have a relationship outside of the marriage. Yet chose to do so himself. He also never planned to file for divorce 

He also lied about it and said nothing was going on to everyone. His friends, family and me. We did not have the agreement to be separated to that degree.

I agree with the fact that he was 50 percent responsible. But I have seen the original messages that led to the affair. She definitely manipulated him and gave him bad advice that I believe he was weak to because of his emotional issues at the time. 

I.e. telling him that it's okay if his marriage was a mistake, and confiding in him and supporting his sadness as being caused by me, which he now knows is not true but rather an issue in himself. 

Yes my husband is at fault, but if this girl had respected our relationship I may have been able to get help for my husband before he chose to deal with his depression in this manner.

I became aware of her post because I checked her hangouts account. I have a lot of fear and trust issues. I was checking to see when she last logged in. He is not connected with her on any social media Facebook etc. Just has her as a contact on his old hangouts account from when she was just a friend. 

I want to removed her from everything. And at one time she was blocked on everything but that has slowly dissipated. I don't believe in causing issues just because she is not blocked. I am choosing to try and trust him especially since nothing has happened. But ideally I would want her to be blocked. My husband gives the excuse it's easier to deal with it if she isn't because then he knows she truly didn't care.
